$comment: What access each requires.features capability needs on the phone (ADR 0013). A package's tier is the most any of its features needs; betterWith is access that lets a feature do more (it works without it). Authors never declare either. folio-pkg reads this file, and Folio's Capability enum is tested against it, so the two can't drift. Tiers, least to most: standard, notifications, accessibility.
